info.name: Archive Auto Tagger & Governance
info.summary: Automatic hierarchical parent folder tagging, per-user upload limit, folder creation restriction, strict document/tag isolation, and dynamic folder-driven tag reconciliation
info.description: Automatically tags files with their hierarchical parent folder names as restricted system tags upon upload, updates tags upon folder rename, prunes surplus orphaned tags on folder delete, enforces per-user upload file size limits, restricts folder hierarchy creation to administrators, strictly enforces per-user document and tag visibility isolation, and provides automated tag lifecycle reconciliation.
info.author: Enterprise Archive System
